customEvals.script: game.user.targets.size === 1 || game.user.targets.size > 9 || ([...game.user.targets].map(t => t.x/game.canvas?.scene?.dimensions?.size ).every((val, index, arr) => arr.every((v, i) => i === index || Math.abs(val - v) <= 2)) && [...game.user.targets].map(t => t.y/game.canvas?.scene?.dimensions?.size ).every((val, index, arr) => arr.every((v, i) => i === index || Math.abs(val - v) <= 2)))

(!!game.combat.flags.FQLogs && (!![...game.combat.flags.FQLogs].filter(log => log.round === game.combat.round && log.actorId === game.user.character.id).filter(l => l.resultArray.filter(r => r.evasion).length).length))

(!game.combat.flags.FQLogs || ![...game.combat.flags.FQLogs].filter(log => log.round === game.combat.round && log.actorId === game.user.character.id)?.pop()) || ([...game.combat.flags.FQLogs].filter(log => log.round === game.combat.round && log.actorId === game.user.character.id)?.pop().cardContent.name === 'Ambush')

game.user.targets.size === 1 || game.user.targets.size > 5 || ([...game.user.targets].filter(pt => [...game.user.targets].filter(t => (Math.abs(t.x - pt.x) === game.canvas?.scene?.dimensions?.size && t.y === pt.y) || (Math.abs(t.y - pt.y) === game.canvas?.scene?.dimensions?.size && t.x === pt.x)).length === [...game.user.targets].length - 1).length >= 1)
